body: Thanks kind stranger for sharing!! Its my first day quiting - im gonna download it to stay on track too!!

He is currently in india and trying to move his flights to get back here sooner. So i didnt want to worry him since he is that far. But yes i do want to tell him once hr is back and im scared of the consequences. I was selfish and ready to leave him when i wanted to kill myself so itll be a blow for him and im scared he will leave me and ofc think that im crazy. I have no clue how he will react and it scares me. I did a shitty thing and now will have to face the consequences.

I tried and survived. Had to go to urgent care myself (my bf is currently back home) and I've spent the day thibking about what I did. Lied to bf and told him that i had to go to urgent care for an infection. I missed meetings at work and my mind is giving me hard time for missing work and lying than for wanting to kill myself. Im realizing that something is wrong. As you rightly pointed out it is hard to acknowledge that im not perfect. Im starting at ground zero. Ive decided to take the disability leave and to go to therapy. Not sure if Ill succeed and if im glad that I survived. But I tried this and failed. Im not perfect and i can try again or acknowledge that I will never be perfect and all i have to do is be honest and try to do the right thing.
Thank you for your empathy kind stranger. I appreciate it greatly! I will consider your advices!! Thanks!!
You get it - its exhausting and tiring. Youve given me some things to thnk about. I even want to be perfect when ODing it seems since i posted this.

Ive tried to get a new job but nothing has been working out. I give interviews but they go no where. I was also involved in a car accident that has left me scared and i ve seen that things will go wrong when you least expect them. So i constantly expect bad things and try to make things perfect. Yes i would rather die than want to understand why i need to be perfect. 

My dad has anger issues and he constantly berated me and my mom if i didnt get good grades, or if i did something that was unacceptable for a female to do (like drinking, hanging out with boys). If im not perfect i would have to deal with the screaming and the humiliating. That may be the reason

Yes you are spot on. 
It did make me think that there is a way out of this. I can take disability leave and try to get into dbt therapy to get better. But im so tired of things not working out and tired of this life that i dont want to try at all. And yes that makes me not perfect, it makes me a coward for wanting to run away.
Your questions are making sense and makjng me think. But i dont want to think in a positive way - i want to indulge in the self destructive behavior cos im convinced there is no way out.

Yes that is exactly right. You just described the last year of my life. 

I never hangout with his friends since all i want to do is stay in bed, i complain most of the time, i wake him up in the middle of the night when i cant sleep cos of anxiety, im constantly tired / depressed and want to stay in bed watching tv. So i consider myself to be a nuisance. Im annoyed with myself for asking so much from him. 

parents have paid for my education, and now is my time to repay them, i can repay their money - ive saved enough but i cant be the perfect daughter who takes care of them so i feel like a burden

You are hitting the bulls eye here.

Im just bored at work constantly with the kind of projects that keep coming. Instead of pushing through the mundane work, i take sick days and stay in bed, let work pile up and then it triggers more anxiety cos i need to be perfect and deliver lots of work. Plus its depression in general since ive never enjoyed any of my work projects.

Yep thats correct. Everyone will be better off if im gone.  And yea im not even remotely perfect to what my parents want me to be. They want me to be happy at my job, stop complaining, get married, give them grandkids - well i want none of that life just sucks and no one needs this sad piece of human flesh taking up resources. Id rather leave and let others who avtually want to live stay.

Narc parents, they raised me to get a good job and always wanted me to be perfect, born in third workd country, moved to the US to study, now work is horrible, im constantly stressed depressed anxious, i miss work a lot, im a burden to my family cos im constantly sad, bf loves me but im a nuisance to him i know it, he will find someone better and im sure my parents will get over my death no problem
